scope: one local staged-mechanics comparison; no external model or MAP01 allocation
world: three discrete rendered stages; one-step linear displacement extrapolation, NOT wall-time motion prediction
prediction: two source observations; no assertion that forecasts constitute fresh evidence
selection: exact-color connected components; source grounding scripted; no trained classifier/VLM
input: real XTest click, fixed fullscreen CSS/root mapping 800x600 at DPR1; verify focus and empty Button1
native: actual Accessibility.getFullAXTree plus DOM.getBoxModel; richer observation capability, not universal pixel claim
scorer: app-side isTrusted click handler -> console receipt; controller never uses receipts for decisions; evaluate after controller termination
changed_development_condition: data URL and localhost navigation rejected by browser policy; network-free page.set_content setup and app console receipts validated before freeze
stop_rule: complete 120 cases once; infrastructure exception retains partial FAIL and stops; no automatic retry; two layout batches checkpointed separately; no selective pooling
metrics: correct/wrong-target/no-effect/abstention, per-channel observation CPU/wall and payload bytes; never provider tokens or model accuracy
limitations: two deterministic layouts, no population reliability
all channels collected for matched evidence even when an arm ignores them; no end-to-end channel cost claim
frame/AX capture sequential, scene quiescent after stage2; check-to-input race not eliminated
coordinate/grid-center/predict are diagnostic controls, not safe production recommendations
shared user-space scorer isolation is not an OS security guarantee
